title: The closed-ball mass x ↦ μ(B_r(x)) of an s-finite measure on ℝ^N is Borel
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) carry its Borel σ-algebra, and let μ be an s-finite measure on ℝ^N. Then for every r ∈ ℝ the map ℝ^N → [0, ∞], x ↦ μ(B_r(x)), is Borel measurable, where B_r(x) = closedBall x r = {y : dist y x ≤ r} is the closed ball (empty when r < 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)), SFinite μ → ∀ r : ℝ, Measurable (fun x : Euclidean N ↦ μ (closedBall x r))
